items.source: Conversions from String to any type will typically use the setAsText method of the PropertyEditor class, or a Spring Converter in a ConversionService.
items.translation: 从 String 到任何类型的转换通常使用 `PropertyEditor` 类的 `setAsText` 方法，或者在 `ConversionService` 中的 Spring Converter。

items.source: Convert the value to the required type (if necessary from a String).
items.translation: 将值转换为所需的类型（如有必要，从字符串转换）。

items.source: requiredType - the type we must convert to (or null if not known, for example in case of a collection element)
items.translation: requiredType - 必须转换的目标类型（或为 null，例如在集合元素的情况下未知）

items.source: TypeMismatchException - if type conversion failed
items.translation: TypeMismatchException - 如果类型转换失败

items.source: the new value, possibly the result of type conversion
items.translation: 新值，可能是类型转换的结果

items.source: Note: Since TypeConverter implementations are typically based on PropertyEditors which aren't thread-safe, TypeConverters themselves are not to be considered as thread-safe either.
items.translation: 注意：由于 TypeConverter 实现通常基于PropertyEditors，而后者并非线程安全，因此 TypeConverters 本身也不应被视为线程安全。

items.source: methodParam - the method parameter that is the target of the conversion (for analysis of generic types; may be null)
items.translation: methodParam - 转换的目标方法参数（用于泛型类型的分析；可能为 null）

items.source: field - the reflective field that is the target of the conversion (for analysis of generic types; may be null)
items.translation: field - 转换的目标反射字段（用于泛型类型的分析；可能为 null）

items.source: typeDescriptor - the type descriptor to use (may be null))
items.translation: typeDescriptor - 要使用的类型描述符（可为 null）
